Slide.Title: vacation (noun)
Slide.SlideText: vacation (noun) Definition: Definition: a period of time for travel, pleasure, or rest Synonyms: Synonyms: holiday, break, time off Examples: Examples: Workers in France receive four weeks of paid vacation each year. Where did you go on your summer vacation? We took a family vacation to Tahiti. We took a family vacation to Tahiti.

Slide.Title: vaccine (noun)
Slide.SlideText: vaccine (noun) Definition: Definition: a substance containing killed or weakened organisms given to a person or animal to prevent disease Synonyms: Synonyms: preventive Examples: Examples: Scientists haven’t found a vaccine for cancer yet. Jonas Salk developed the polio vaccine in 1952. In 2010, there was a shortage of H1N1 vaccine. In 2010, there was a shortage of H1N1 vaccine.

Slide.Title: valley (noun)
Slide.SlideText: valley (noun) Definition: Definition: a low area of land between mountains or hills Synonyms: Synonyms: basin, canyon, gorge Examples: Examples: Squaw Valley, California, is one of the largest ski resorts in the United States. The valley was twenty miles wide. We hiked through a beautiful green valley. We hiked through a beautiful green valley.

Slide.Title: value (noun)
Slide.SlideText: value (noun) Definition: Definition: 1) the amount of money that could be received if something were sold; 2) the quality of being useful, important, or desired Synonyms: Synonyms: 1) worth; 2) importance Examples: Examples: 1) Your friendship has great value to me. (importance) 2) What is the value of an average home in your area? (worth) What is the value of an average home in your area?

Slide.Title: vegetable (noun)
Slide.SlideText: vegetable (noun) Definition: Definition: a plant grown for food, such as carrots or lettuce Synonyms: Synonyms: green, produce Examples: Examples: Broccoli is one of the healthiest vegetables. Bok choy is a vegetable used in Chinese cooking. Charlie doesn’t like eating vegetables. Charlie doesn’t like eating vegetables.

Slide.Title: vehicle (noun)
Slide.SlideText: vehicle (noun) Definition: Definition: any form of transportation, especially a car or truck Synonyms: Synonyms: automobile Examples: Examples: George can drive almost any kind of vehicle. His favorite vehicle is a 1960 Ford truck. Soldiers go on patrol in a military vehicle. Soldiers go on patrol in a military vehicle.

Slide.Title: version (noun)
Slide.SlideText: version (noun) Definition: Definition: the form or variety of something that is different from others and from the original Synonyms: Synonyms: form, rendition Examples: Examples: The book is available in both hard and soft-cover versions. This dictionary isn’t the most recent version. I just bought the latest version of this MP3 player. I just bought the latest version of this MP3 player.

Slide.Title: veto (verb)
Slide.SlideText: veto (verb) Definition: Definition: to vote against something or refuse to approve Synonyms: Synonyms: deny, refuse, reject Examples: Examples: The President vetoed the law after Congress passed it. Janet’s parents vetoed her summer plans. The bank vetoed my student loan application. The bank vetoed my student loan application.

Slide.Title: victim (noun)
Slide.SlideText: victim (noun) Definition: Definition: someone or something that is injured, killed, or made to suffer Synonyms: Synonyms: sufferer, casualty Examples: Examples: He is the victim of a terrible crime. Victims of the hurricane received financial aid from the government. The firefighter helped the car-accident victim. The firefighter helped the car-accident victim.

Slide.Title: victory (noun)
Slide.SlideText: victory (noun) Definition: Definition: success in a fight or competition Synonyms: Synonyms: achievement, conquest, win Examples: Examples: Winning the election was a great victory for the candidate’s political party. It was a victory for the whole country when he finished first in the race. It was a victory for the whole country when he finished first in the race.

Slide.Title: video (noun)
Slide.SlideText: video (noun) Definition: Definition: a method of recording images and sound without a traditional film camera for showing on a television, computer, or other device Synonyms: Synonyms: tape Examples: Examples: 1) A friend filmed a video of our wedding. 2) My friend always shoots videos of the fun things we do together. My friend always shoots videos of the fun things we do together.

Slide.Title: village (noun)
Slide.SlideText: village (noun) Definition: Definition: a very small town Synonyms: Synonyms: hamlet Examples: Examples: She was born in a remote village in Nepal. The village does not have a post office. The village is located high up in the mountains. The village is located high up in the mountains.

Slide.Title: violate (verb)
Slide.SlideText: violate (verb) Definition: Definition: 1) to fail to obey or honor (a law); 2) to break (an agreement) Synonyms: Synonyms: 1) break (a law); 2) disregard, breach Examples: Examples: We sued the insurance company because it violated the terms of our policy. (breached) My uncle got a ticket for violating a traffic law. (breaking) My uncle got a ticket for violating a traffic law.

Slide.Title: violence (noun)
Slide.SlideText: violence (noun) Definition: Definition: the use of force to cause injury, death, or damage Synonyms: Synonyms: force, brutality Examples: Examples: People were told to stay indoors because of the violence in the streets. Many parents believe that there is too much violence on TV. Many parents believe that there is too much violence on TV.

Slide.Title: virus (noun)
Slide.SlideText: virus (noun) Definition: Definition: a microscopic organism that causes disease Synonyms: Synonyms: germ, microbe, pathogen Examples: Examples: She caught a virus and had to stay home from work. Under a microscope, some viruses appear quite beautiful. Under a microscope, some viruses appear quite beautiful.

Slide.Title: visa (noun)
Slide.SlideText: visa (noun) Definition: Definition: the official permission given to a person to enter a country where he or she is not a citizen Synonyms: Synonyms: pass, permit Examples: Examples: Americans need a visa to travel to China. We don’t need a visa to go to France. I have many visas in my passport because I travel a lot for my job. I have many visas in my passport because I travel a lot for my job.

Slide.Title: visit (verb)
Slide.SlideText: visit (verb) Definition: Definition: to go or come to a place for a short time for friendly or business reasons Synonyms: Synonyms: drop in, stop by Examples: Examples: I can’t wait to visit my grandmother. Which countries have you visited? It’s fun to visit old friends. It’s fun to visit old friends.

Slide.Title: voice (noun)
Slide.SlideText: voice (noun) Definition: Definition: the sound made by creatures, especially humans, for speaking Synonyms: Synonyms: speech Examples: Examples: The opera singer has a beautiful voice. My teacher has a very soft voice. Singers use microphones to make their voices louder. Singers use microphones to make their voices louder.

Slide.Title: volcano (noun)
Slide.SlideText: volcano (noun) Definition: Definition: a hill or mountain around a hole in the earth’s surface that can explode, sending hot, melted rock and ash into the air Synonyms: Synonyms: eruption Examples: Examples: It’s dangerous to live near a volcano. The 2010 eruption of a volcano in Iceland caused many problems for European travelers. The 2010 eruption of a volcano in Iceland caused many problems for European travelers.

Slide.Title: vote (verb)
Slide.SlideText: vote (verb) Definition: Definition: 1) to choose a candidate in an election; 2) to choose a position in favor of or against a question or issue Synonyms: Synonyms: 1) cast a ballot; 2) decide Examples: Examples: Americans vote for a new president every four years. (cast a ballot) I didn’t vote in the last election. (cast a ballot) The employees voted on the manager’s proposal. (decided) The employees voted on the manager’s proposal.

Slide.Title: vote (noun)
Slide.SlideText: vote (noun) Definition: Definition: a choice or decision expressed by the voice, by hand, or by writing Synonyms: Synonyms: choice, pick Examples: Examples: She won the election by just three votes. The family took a vote on the type of restaurant they wanted to go to for dinner. Every vote counts in an election. Every vote counts in an election.
